## Interpretation

All36rallies are matched; boundary/semantic accuracy is not perfect merely because detectionF1=1. The raw-source OCR20:20 is consistent with pixels, while provided10:9/9:10scores have incompatible conventions. Preserve unknown named identities and distinguish generated output disagreement from independently labelled accuracy.

## Code changes and relevance

Verified independent regression defects are being repaired in an isolated copy of the actual inherited improved code. Reopened-rally cut-frontier and repeated-score-transition vote defects are genuine contract bugs; current evidence has not shown they caused baseline Test1 errors. Nonidentity camera-foot projection is a verified mathematical invariant defect but Test1 camera matrices are identity. No video metric gain may be claimed from those unit tests alone. Fresh full-video before/after evidence is required.

## Next-test gate

Test2 remains gated on Test1 diagnosis, justified fixes and recorded regression comparison. Unsupported labels and ambiguous annotation conventions remain documented limitations; do not invent fixes/ground truth to report all issues solved.
